prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1432; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision described in the enclosed materials. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage policy limits applicable to the insured driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this incident and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence related to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle telematics data, recorded statements, claim notes, repair estimates, and any other documents or electronic data in your possession or control. Destruction or alteration of such materials may result in serious consequences in any subsequent litigation.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
